title: Idea: Homepage hire-path tightening
description:
Parked for committee discussion. Do not implement until Ryan or Publicist says go.

Continues the parked hire-path brief (1b53c5) after the recent homepage pass. Hero H1 stays "Depend on proven experts." This is sequence and deletion, not new messaging.

Proposed tightening:
1. Cut B0rd from the homepage. It sits between Platform and the case studies and sends people to hardware, Etsy, and a spinoff story. B0rd already has a strip; do not also feature it on the hire path.
2. One contact button. Keep the hero "Tell us the problem." Change Approach "Contact us" to a text link to the Cybernetic Development article.
3. Make the case cards scannable: who / what broke / what you did / one number. Call Criteria and Venue Driver already have the stories; they still read as paragraphs.
4. Cheap copy cleanup: homepage page-level SEO still says "In production since 2023" (fights the 14-year line). Replace "Please see our Posts for more" with shorter voice.

Related, do not treat as the same ask: if the touch-page wiggle stays gone, consider dropping body { touch-action: pan-y } later (it can block pinch-zoom). Keep overflow-x hidden.

Do not reopen the hero rewrite.

comments.text: Ryan, 2026-09-26: proceed. Implementing items 1 to 4 now under epic a65429, with the hero button retargeted to the new /engage page. H1 unchanged.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text:
Implemented items 1-4 in src/pages/index.js only (plus src/components/index.module.css):

1. Cut B0rd from homepage: removed the "SPINOFF" section and its b0rdSolution GraphQL query. B0rd's own page and blog entry are untouched.
2. One contact button: removed the "Contact us" button in the Approach section, kept "Read Cybernetic Development". Removed the now-unused local contactUrl const (not needed elsewhere on the page, so no import was added).
3. Case cards restructured to 4 scannable lines each (who / what broke / what we did / one number), using only facts already on the cards:
   - Call Criteria: "Call center QA, scored by human reviewers." / "Their QA couldn't scale without scaling headcount." / "We built a self-evolving RLHF system: reviewers correct the AI and say why, and it turns the explanation into policy." / "100% of calls reviewed, up from a sample."
   - Venue Driver: "Ticketing and reservations backbone for Las Vegas nightlife." / "An AWS data center failed catastrophically." / "We relocated the entire system within hours — ticket scanning never stopped." / "16 years of continuous operation."
   Added .caseFacts CSS for the line layout.
4. Copy cleanup: Seo description now reads "...grounded in 14 years of production operations." (matching about.js/gatsby-config.mjs phrasing) instead of "In production since 2023." Footer line under Recent Posts shortened to "More in Posts." (the Articles footer line was left as-is; only the Posts line was named in the task).

Hero button retargeted to /engage per 1b53c5's plan (see that task's comment for the hero copy). H1 unchanged. Ran prettier --write and --check on the touched files; both clean. Did not run build/dev per instructions. Not committed/pushed — leaving that to the parent session.
